liquefaction.title: Liquefaction
liquefaction.description: Factor of safety and LPI from SPT and CPT data.
liquefaction.analysis.title: Liquefaction analysis
liquefaction.analysis.subtitle: Choose the profile and the method, then run. Earthquake values come from the project screen when it has them.
liquefaction.profile.label: Soil profile
liquefaction.profile.none: The project has no soil profile. Create one in the Soil module first.
liquefaction.help.default_fc: Used for SPT points that have no laboratory data.
liquefaction.help.gwt_seismic: Enter only if it differs from the profile.
liquefaction.error.number_invalid: Enter a valid number or leave it empty.
liquefaction.error.amax_range: a_max must be between 0 and 2 g.
liquefaction.error.target_fs_min: The target factor of safety must be at least 1.0.
liquefaction.error.profile_missing: The soil profile you chose no longer exists. Reload the profiles and pick another one.
liquefaction.error.no_soil_source: The project has no active soil profile. Create and activate one in the Soil module, then run again.
liquefaction.results.title: Liquefaction results
liquefaction.results.no_job: There is no analysis to show. Run the analysis first.
liquefaction.results.unavailable: The result of this analysis could not be reached. Run the analysis again.
liquefaction.results.stale: The soil data changed after this calculation. Run it again for a current result.
liquefaction.results.failed: The analysis could not finish. Check the inputs and try again.
liquefaction.results.cancelled: The analysis was cancelled; there is no result.
liquefaction.results.empty: The analysis produced no result. Check the inputs.
liquefaction.results.lpi_incomplete: The factor of safety could not be calculated at some points. They count as 0, so the LPI may be lower than it should be (*).
liquefaction.results.errors_title: Soundings that could not be calculated
liquefaction.results.chart_csr_crr: Earthquake load (CSR) and soil resistance (CRR) – depth chart
liquefaction.results.warnings_scope: Warnings apply to the whole sounding, not to a single depth.
liquefaction.results.fs_clipped: FS > {max}: drawn at the chart edge (exact value in the table).
liquefaction.warning.spt_iteration_not_c: The (N1)60cs calculation did not converge at {count} point(s).
liquefaction.warning.spt_refusal_lower_b: Refusal blow counts are lower bounds of the true value; FS at these points is on the safe side.
liquefaction.warning.ic_undefined: Ic could not be calculated at {count} point(s) (net qc ≤ 0, fs ≤ 0 or invalid stress). These points were treated as invalid.
liquefaction.warning.fc_from_ic: Fines content (FC) was estimated from Ic with C_FC = {c_fc}.
liquefaction.warning.cpt_iteration_not_c: The qc1Ncs calculation did not converge at {count} point(s).
liquefaction.warning.simplified_depth: Below {depth} m the simplified procedure is less reliable.
liquefaction.warning.default_fc: Default FC = {fc}% used at depth(s) {depths} m (no laboratory FC).
liquefaction.warning.msf_andrus_stokoe_h: Youd (2001) recommends the Idriss MSF for M > 7.5. The selected Andrus-Stokoe MSF is lower in this range, so the result is on the safe side.
liquefaction.results.mock_note: These are sample values, not a real calculation.
liquefaction.results.ratio_clipped: CSR/CRR > {max} (twice the largest CSR): drawn at the chart edge (exact value in the table).
liquefaction.help.target_fs: At least 1.0. Points with FS between 1.0 and this number count as "marginal".
liquefaction.help.c_fc: Used to estimate fines content (FC) from CPT data.
liquefaction.help.ic_cutoff: CPT points above it are treated as clay and left out of the calculation.
liquefaction.advanced: Advanced: fines content for SPT points without laboratory data
liquefaction.check.title: Before running
liquefaction.bar.hint_missing: The analysis can run once the missing fields are filled in.
liquefaction.bar.hint_ready: All inputs are set. You can run the analysis.
liquefaction.results.lead: For each sounding: the smallest factor of safety (FS) and the liquefaction potential index (LPI).
liquefaction.results.chart_hint: Red points are counted as liquefiable (FS below 1.0). The dashed line marks FS = 1.0.
liquefaction.results.verdict.min_fs: Smallest factor of safety {fs}: sounding {id}, {depth} m.
liquefaction.results.verdict.none: Liquefaction is not expected at any point.
liquefaction.results.verdict.none_with_e: Liquefaction is not expected at the calculated points, but {count} sounding(s) could not be calculated.
liquefaction.results.verdict.no_fs: The factor of safety could not be calculated.
liquefaction.results.verdict.no_fs_hint: There are no valid points. Check the inputs and the warnings.
